name: gasman-tms
description: GasMan Transport Management System - demo / production foundation (MK TechSol)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @gasman/api" "npm run dev -w @gasman/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gasman/api && npm run build -w @gasman/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gasman/shared && npm run typecheck -w @gasman/api && npm run typecheck -w @gasman/web
